settings.mission: To make an inventory tracking system in all business effortless
settings.aboutText:
UC Bar Infotech Pvt. Ltd. is a specialist in Barcode Scanners & Printers, Labels, Stickers, Ribbons and a technology partner for inventory tracking in Manufacturing, Logistics, Warehouse and Retail.

Our business focus is Office & Industrial Automation, customized software solutions and Logistic & Warehouse Management.

Our range includes high-performance scanners, barcode label printers, barcode software, labels and thermal transfer ribbons, Point of Sale systems and hardware, RFID products, industrial lighting and vision systems, PDAs, accessories and barcode verifiers. We stock all major brands including Motorola, Honeywell, TVS, Zebex, SATO, TSC, Argox and Datalogic.

Our aim is to consistently present you with top quality independent advice and service, with specialist expertise and outstanding customer support — backed by competitive prices and barcode products stocked for immediate delivery.
settings.softwareIntro: Our team of experienced software professionals continuously develops applications to meet your company goals, and we provide customised applications at a reasonable price — for example Visitor Tracking, Online Courier Tracking, Work-in-Progress applications, PLC/HMI and test-bench machine integration with barcode sticker printing, carton/packet sticker printing, and Mobile Terminal apps for stock taking, material loading/unloading and component tracking.

faqs.question: What products do you sell?
faqs.answer: Barcode scanners, barcode printers, ID card printers, mobile terminals and printers, RFID readers and tags, labels and barcodes, and thermal transfer ribbons — plus software applications for manufacturing, logistics, warehouse and retail.

faqs.question: Which brands do you stock?
faqs.answer: We work with top brands including Motorola, Honeywell, Zebra, SATO, TSC, Datalogic, Argox, TVS, Zebex and more.

faqs.question: Do you offer discounts on bulk orders?
faqs.answer: Yes. For bulk orders of labels, ribbons, printers and scanners you get a discounted rate for a cost-effective purchase. Send us your requirement for a quote.

faqs.question: Can you build custom software for us?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our software team builds customised applications on request — for example visitor tracking, courier tracking, work-in-progress tracking, PLC/HMI integration, carton sticker printing and mobile terminal apps for stock taking and material loading/unloading.

faqs.question: Do you provide support online and offline?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide software and hardware support both online and offline.

faqs.question: How do I get a quote?
faqs.answer: Use the quote form on the Contact page, message us on WhatsApp, or call the toll-free number.

faqs.question: Do you print barcode labels for customers?
faqs.answer: Yes — we also take orders for printing barcode labels. Share the label size, quantity and your design or barcode data through the quote form or WhatsApp and our team will send you a quote.
